Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Target 1 face-down Defense Position monster on the field; flip it face-up, then destroy it if its DEF is 2000 or less, or return it face-down if its DEF is more than 2000.

Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Seiyaryu

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Sinister Serpent
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can add it to your hand, also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your GY during your opponent's next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Sinister Serpent" once per turn.

Prismatic Secret Rare.name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
Prismatic Secret Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" from your hand and/or field. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 "Alpha The Magnet Warrior", "Beta The Magnet Warrior", and "Gamma The Magnet Warrior" in your Graveyard; Special Summon them.
